items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 43:1
items.html: From the Chazeh downward of ZA, which is the place of the two thirds of Tifferet and NHYM of ZA, is called the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil; for since the Hassadim are revealed there, the shells, which are called evil, have a grip. But from the Chazeh upward, where the Hassadim are covered, the shells have no grip there, and it is called the Tree of Life; for the light of the posterior of Bina illuminates there, and Bina is called “the life of the King.” (p. 673, Item 79, and Inner Light there, Sub Header, “And the reason”)
